purpose: Dataset for a browser extension that identifies Israeli e-commerce websites that observe Shabbat.
audit_note: Every domain below was fetched and inspected on 2026-08-16. Entries with no first-party Shabbat evidence, or that were dead/unreachable, were removed (see removed[]). 'status' reflects what the audit actually found, not the original unverified claims. A second live pass on 2026-08-22 (Shabbat, Israeli IP) tested 30 mainstream-chain candidates by rendering each site and driving a real add-to-cart/checkout attempt; all but B&H were rejected because they traded normally during Shabbat (see removed[]).

status_definitions.site_blocked: A real closure mechanism blocks browsing/purchase on Shabbat (a closure page, a shomer-shabbat blocking plugin/iframe, or a Shabbat open/close time config in the site code).
status_definitions.purchase_blocked: The site's own terms state purchasing/donating is unavailable on Shabbat, or a live block on the cart/checkout was observed while browsing stayed open.
status_definitions.operations_paused: The site declares that orders/shipping/employee actions pause on Shabbat (browsing may stay open).
status_definitions.declared_shabbat_observant: The site displays a first-party 'אתר שומר שבת' declaration/badge, but no technical block was observed.

confidence_definitions.verified: Audit saw an actual Shabbat closure page/mechanism first-hand.
confidence_definitions.high: Audit confirmed a first-party declaration or mechanism in the page source.
confidence_definitions.medium: Evidence present but weaker (e.g. only a config value, or redirect/access quirks during fetch).

notes: Re-verified live during Shabbat on 2026-08-21 from an Israeli IP: closures were confirmed by rendering the site during Shabbat, not merely inferred from source.

2026-08-22 pass targeted large mainstream Israeli chains (supermarkets, appliances, footwear, sleep, housewares) that are widely said to keep Shabbat: verification drove a real add-to-cart and checkout attempt during Shabbat, and every one of them completed it. Off-line Shabbat observance in branches does not imply an online closure.
bhphotovideo.com is the one non-Israeli listing: it blocks checkout sitewide for Shabbat and Jewish holidays, which is exactly what the extension flags.
Only site_blocked / purchase_blocked / operations_paused get the firm 'האתר סגור בשבת' headline; declared_shabbat_observant gets 'האתר שומר שבת'.
Client-side blockers (AutoPeak, HolyClock, shomershabes widget) often do not actually block and were downgraded to declared unless a real closure was seen.
Re-verify periodically; store policies and site implementations change.
